system: You are the Data Scout of a nonprofit-finance theory-testing pipeline. You map the variables of a theory to columns of an organization-year panel. You may only use column names from the list you are given. You never compute or estimate anything. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else.
prompt:
Theory: Where joblessness is high, nonprofits owe more relative to what they own.

Panel columns you may use (name: meaning (level)):
- acs_estimated: True for county rows estimated (rebuilt Connecticut regions), not published by ACS (county-year)
- admin_expense_ratio: Management and general expenses / total functional expenses, 0-1 (administrative overhead) (organization-year)
- avg_housing_burden: Population-weighted mean housing-cost burden of the county's tracts, percent (NORP disadvantaged communities) (county-year)
- below_poverty: People below the poverty line (ACS count) (county-year)
- category: NORP sector category of the organization (e.g. health, education, human services) (organization)
- civilian_labor_force: Civilian labor force (ACS count) (county-year)
- contributions: Contributions, gifts and grants received, US dollars (organization-year)
- county_fips: 5-digit county FIPS code of the organization (NORP NGO table); the unit county exposures are assigned at (key)
- ein: IRS employer identification number of the organization (key)
- equity_ratio: End-of-year net assets / revenue (reserves measured in years of revenue) (organization-year)
- expenses_total: Total expenses, current year (Part I), US dollars (organization-year)
- food_desert_share: Population-weighted share of the county's tracts flagged as food deserts (NORP disadvantaged communities) (county-year)
- fundraising_efficiency: Cost of raising one dollar: fundraising expenses / contributions; higher = more expensive fundraising (organization-year)
- fundraising_expense_p01: Professional fundraising fees reported in Part I, US dollars (organization-year)
- fundraising_expense_ratio: Fundraising expenses / total functional expenses, 0-1 (organization-year)
- has_county: True when the organization is linked to a county (organization-year)
- has_need: True when the organization's county has need-table data for that year (organization-year)
- has_p09: True when the filing has a Part IX row (organization-year)
- has_p10: True when the filing has a Part X row (organization-year)
- high_need: True for the top quarter of counties on need_index in that year (binary exposure) (county-year)
- liabilities_to_assets: Total liabilities / total assets; higher = more debt, more financially vulnerable (organization-year)
- log_revenue: Natural log of total revenue (missing when revenue <= 0); the size control (derived) (organization-year)
- median_household_income: County median household income (ACS 5-year), US dollars (county-year)
- need_index: Economic need index: mean of z-scores of poverty rate, unemployment rate and minus log median income; higher = more need (county-year)
- net_assets_boy: Net assets or fund balances at the beginning of the year, US dollars (organization-year)
- net_assets_eoy: Net assets or fund balances at the end of the year, US dollars (organization-year)
- operating_margin: (Revenue - expenses) / revenue; negative = deficit (organization-year)
- p09_fundraising_expense: Fundraising expenses (Part IX column D), US dollars (organization-year)
- p09_management_expense: Management and general expenses (Part IX column C), US dollars (organization-year)
- p09_program_expense: Program service expenses (Part IX column B), US dollars (organization-year)
- p09_total_expense: Total functional expenses (Part IX column A), US dollars (organization-year)
- population: County population (ACS 5-year) (county-year)
- poverty_rate: Share of people below the poverty line in the county, 0-1 (ACS) (county-year)
- poverty_universe: People for whom poverty status is determined (ACS denominator) (county-year)
- program_expense_ratio: Program expenses / total functional expenses, 0-1; higher = more spent on programs (organization-year)
- program_revenue: Program service revenue, US dollars (organization-year)
- rating_components: How many of the four ratios standard_rating averages (2-4) (organization-year)
- return_type: Form type filed: 990 (full), 990EZ; ratio theories use 990 only (organization-year)
- revenue_concentration: Herfindahl index over contributions, program revenue and other revenue; 1 = a single source, 1/3 = evenly split (organization-year)
- revenue_growth: Revenue change from the previous tax year / previous revenue (organization-year)
- revenue_total: Total revenue, current year (Form 990 Part I), US dollars (organization-year)
- salaries: Salaries, compensation and employee benefits, US dollars (organization-year)
- standard_rating: Context-blind 0-10 financial rating: mean score of program share, admin share, fundraising cost and liabilities-to-assets (docs/ratings_theory.md) (organization-year)
- state: Two-letter state of the organization; used for state fixed effects and the state hold-out (organization)
- tax_year: Tax year of the Form 990 filing (2018-2022) (key)
- total_assets_eoy: Total assets at end of year (Part X), US dollars (organization-year)
- total_liabilities_eoy: Total liabilities at end of year (Part X), US dollars (organization-year)
- unemployed: Unemployed people in the civilian labor force (ACS count) (county-year)
- unemployment_rate: Share of the civilian labor force unemployed in the county, 0-1 (ACS) (county-year)

Return {"outcome": <column>, "exposure": <column>, "exposure_type": "binary" or "continuous", "exposure_unit": <column the exposure is assigned at, e.g. county_fips>, "controls": [<columns>], "notes": <one sentence>}.
text: {"outcome": "liabilities_to_assets", "exposure": "unemployment_rate", "exposure_type": "continuous", "exposure_unit": "county_fips", "controls": ["log_revenue", "category", "state", "tax_year", "return_type"], "notes": "Nonprofits owing more relative to what they own maps to liabilities_to_assets (liabilities divided by assets), and joblessness maps to the county-level unemployment_rate; controls are size, sector, state and year, with the sample restricted to full 990 filers."}
